decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets in allowed context [500,699]: (1) a major multi-axis step beginning at index 538 (U↓~15, E↑~25, N↑~10), sustained through 580 with no return—confirmed as temporary offset pending later recovery; (2) a secondary perturbation near 575 (U↓~5, E↑~5), superimposed on the first offset, with no observed return by index 664—status uncertain. Axes show coupled but non-uniform responses; no evidence of full reversal within allowed window.

intervals.observation: U drops sharply ~15 units between 538–542, E jumps +25 units and N rises ~10 units over same interval; all three axes show sustained offset through ~580 with no return. The step at 538 (per optional jump) aligns with onset of multi-axis shift. No opposing return observed before 580; interior shows stable offset level. Status: confirmed temporary offset (pending return beyond allowed context).

After initial offset, U shows secondary drop ~−5 around 575–578, coinciding with smaller E +5 and N +~2 adjustments; this appears as a second transient perturbation superimposed on prior offset. No clear return to pre-575 level observed within allowed context (ends at 664); U remains depressed relative to 542–574 plateau. Status: uncertain—onset clear, but return unobserved/ambiguous.
